D1-071.q: Ek company résumé-screening model ko das saal ke purane hiring faislon par train karti hai, jab zyada tar mard bharti kiye gaye the. Ab model utni hi qabil khawateen ko neeche rank karta hai. Asal masla kya hai?
opts: Fairness ka masla jo training data ke bias se paida hua
Applicants ke data ki privacy breach
Sust hardware ki wajah se reliability ka masla
Transparency feature jo apne design ke mutabiq kaam kar raha hai
D1-071.exp: Model apne training data se patterns seekhta hai, is liye agar purane faislay biased the to model wahi bias dohrata hai aur ek jaisi qabliyat wale groups ke saath alag sulook karta hai, jo fairness principle ke khilaf hai. Yahan koi zaati data zahir nahi hua, is liye yeh privacy breach nahi. Hardware ki raftar ka ranking se koi taalluq nahi, aur transparency system ko samjhane ke baare mein hai, ghair barabar nateeje ke baare mein nahi.

D1-072.q: Refunds manzoor karne wala ek AI system nuqsan deh faisla karta hai. Accountability principle ke mutabiq zimmedar kaun hai?
opts: AI model khud
System ke peeche maujood log aur idara
Sirf woh customer jis ne shuru mein refund maanga tha
Koi nahi, kyunke faisla software ne khud kiya
D1-072.exp: Accountability ka matlab hai ke AI system design, build aur deploy karne wale log us ke kaam aur asar ke jawabdeh rehte hain. Model ko zimmedar nahi thehraya ja sakta, aur zimmedari customer par nahi jati aur na sirf is wajah se khatam hoti hai ke faisla automatic tha. Idare governance, muqarrar owners, reviews aur ghaltiyan theek karne ke tareeqon se accountability dikhate hain.

D1-073.q: Ek voice assistant sirf jawan native speakers ke saath design aur test kiya gaya tha. Ab team design reviews aur testing mein buzurg users, bolne ki dushwari wale log aur mukhtalif accents wale log shamil karti hai. Woh kaunsa principle apna rahe hain?
D1-073.exp: Inclusiveness teams se kehta hai ke aisa AI design karein jo sab ko ba-ikhtiyar banaye, aur is ka ahem tareeqa mukhtalif salahiyaton aur pas-manzar ke logon ko design aur testing mein shamil karna hai. Accountability governance aur ownership ke baare mein hai, privacy and security data ki hifazat ke baare mein, aur transparency logon ko system samjhane ke baare mein, is liye koi bhi design mein mukhtalif users laane ko bayan nahi karta.

D1-074.q: Microsoft Foundry ke image-generation models se bani tasveeron mein Content Credentials hote hain jo dikhate hain ke yeh AI ne banayi hain. Yeh asal mein kaunse responsible AI principle ko support karta hai?
D1-074.exp: Content Credentials bani hui tasveeron mein un ke asal (provenance) ki maloomat jorte hain taake log dekh sakein ke yeh AI ne banayi hain. Yeh batana ke content AI ka bana hua hai transparency hai, kyunke log samajh jate hain ke woh kya dekh rahe hain. Reliability and safety mehfooz aur musalsal kaam ke baare mein hai, fairness barabar sulook ke baare mein, aur accountability is baare mein ke system ka jawabdeh kaun hai, is liye yeh label ka asal maqsad nahi.

D1-075.q: Privacy and security ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Chat logs ko by default ghair muayyan muddat tak rakhna privacy ka sifarish kiya hua tareeqa hai.
Microsoft Foundry mein Azure OpenAI models ko bheje gaye prompts aur completions OpenAI ke public models train karne ke liye istemal hote hain.
AI app ke data tak role-based access control se rasai mehdood karna privacy and security principle ko support karta hai.
D1-075.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: privacy ka tareeqa yeh hai ke zaati data sirf zaroorat tak rakha jaye, is liye har log hamesha rakhne se khatra barhta hai. Doosre ka Nahi: Microsoft kehta hai ke customers ke prompts aur completions OpenAI models train karne ke liye istemal nahi hote aur OpenAI ko dastiyab nahi. Teesre ka Haan: role-based access control yaqeeni banata hai ke sirf manzoor shuda identities data tak pohanchein, jis se data mehfooz rehta hai.

D1-076.q: Generative AI chatbot ke release se pehle aur baad mein kaunse TEEN tareeqay reliability and safety ko support karte hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Tamam logging band kar dein taake kuch review na ho sake
Fallback rakhna, jaise user ko kisi insan ke hawale karna
Chatbot ko mukhalifana aur nuqsan deh prompts se red-team karein
Hamesha sab se zyada temperature rakhein
Test dataset par jawab evaluate karein aur release ke baad bhi monitoring jari rakhein
D1-076.exp: Red teaming release se pehle kamzoriyan dhoondti hai, evaluation aur monitoring dikhate hain ke chatbot waqt ke saath kaisa chal raha hai, aur fallback us waqt nuqsan kam karta hai jab woh hifazat se jawab na de sake. Logs ke baghair masail ki tehqeeq nahi ho sakti, aur sab se zyada temperature jawabon ko kam qabil-e-peshgoi banata hai.

D1-077.q: Har tafseel ko Microsoft ke responsible AI principle se milayein. Har principle ek baar istemal hota hai.
items: AI systems sab logon ke saath insaaf se pesh aayein
AI systems bharosemand aur mehfooz tareeqe se kaam karein
AI systems mehfooz hon aur privacy ka khayal rakhein
AI systems sab ko ba-ikhtiyar banayein aur logon ko shamil karein
AI systems samajh mein aane wale hon
Log AI systems ke jawabdeh hon
D1-077.exp: Yeh chhe jumlay Microsoft ke responsible AI principles ki chhoti tareefein hain: insaaf wala sulook fairness hai, bharosemand aur mehfooz kaam reliability and safety hai, mehfooz aur private hona privacy and security hai, sab ko ba-ikhtiyar banana inclusiveness hai, samajh mein aana transparency hai, aur logon ka jawabdeh hona accountability hai. Har principle ki ek jumlay wali tareef yaad ho to scenario wale sawal aasan ho jate hain.

D1-078.q: Jild ki beemariyon ka ek model kul mila kar 95% sahi hai, lekin gehri rangat wale logon ke liye sirf 70% sahi hai. Team ko agla qadam kya uthana chahiye?
opts: Model abhi release kar dena, kyunke majmui accuracy pehle se zyada hai
Ghalat alarms kam karne ke liye tamam users ki faislay ki had barhana
Tasveeron se jild ka rang hata dein
Har group ko alag napna aur kamzor groups ke liye training data behtar karna
D1-078.exp: Kul score kuch groups ke bohat kharab nateejon ko chupa sakta hai. Har group ke metrics alag naapna, jise aksar disaggregated evaluation kehte hain, farq dikhata hai, aur kam numaindagi wale groups ka munasib data shamil karna usay kam karta hai, jo fairness ko support karta hai. Sirf average dekh kar release karna nuqsan ko nazar andaz karta hai. Sab ke liye ek threshold badalne se farq khatam nahi hota, aur medical tasveeron se rang yunhi nahi hataya ja sakta.

D1-079.q: Har khali jagah ke liye sahi option chun kar jumla mukammal karein.
D1-079.tpl: Microsoft ke responsible AI principles yeh hain: fairness, reliability and safety, {0}, inclusiveness, transparency, aur {1}.
D1-079.exp: Microsoft ke chhe responsible AI principles fairness, reliability and safety, privacy and security, inclusiveness, transparency aur accountability hain. Speed, profitability, scalability aur availability karobari ya technical maqasid ho sakte hain, lekin woh responsible AI principles nahi. Chhe ki poori list yaad ho to pehchanna aasan hota hai ke scenario kaunse principle ko bayan kar raha hai.

D1-080.q: Ek hospital aisa AI assistant banata hai jo batata hai ke mareez ko kitni jaldi dekhna chahiye. Kaunsa design reliability and safety ko sab se behtar support karta hai?
opts: Staff masroof ho to model ko review ke baghair apni tajaweez par amal karne dena
Amal se pehle mustanad clinician har tajweez ko review kare
Model ka confidence staff se chupayein
Content filters band karna taake hangami halat mein staff ko jaldi jawab milein
D1-080.exp: Bare asar wale scenarios mein agar insan amal se pehle AI ki tajaweez review kare to model ke ghalat hone par nuqsan ka imkan kam hota hai, jo reliability and safety ko support karta hai. Review ke baghair amal karne se yeh hifazat khatam hoti hai. Confidence chupane se woh ishara hat jata hai jo logon ko output parakhne mein madad deta hai. Content filters band karne se safety kamzor hoti hai aur tajaweez zyada bharosemand nahi hotin.

opts: Tayyar jawabon ka database jis mein har sawal par talash hoti hai
Rules engine jis mein developers haath se likhte hain ke har sawal ka kya jawab ho
Bohat se text par train model jo zaban samajhta aur banata hai
Spreadsheet macro jo text format karta hai
D1-081.exp: Large language model neural network hai, aam taur par transformer architecture par mabni, jo bohat bari text collections par train hota hai taake sawalon ke jawab dene, khulasa karne aur likhne jaise kaamon ke liye qudrati zaban samajh aur bana sake. Woh tayyar jawab mehfooz nahi karta, haath se likha rules engine nahi, aur formatting macro bhi nahi.

D1-082.q: Generative AI solution mein prompt kya hota hai?
opts: Woh input jo aap model ko bhejte hain
Woh data jis par model release se pehle train hua
Us model deployment ka naam jise aap call karte hain
Apni app mein model istemal karne ka mahana bill
D1-082.exp: Prompt woh input hai jo aap generative model ko dete hain, jaise sawal, hidayat, misaalein ya izafi context, aur model us se jawab banata hai. Training data woh hai jis se model ne deploy hone se pehle seekha. Deployment ka naam model endpoint ki pehchan hai, aur bill ka request mein model ke istemal se taalluq nahi.

D1-083.q: Large language model ke muqable mein small language model, jaise Phi model, ka faida kaunsa bayan batata hai?
opts: Har kaam mein bare model se hamesha zyada sahi jawab deta hai
Us ki context window la-mehdood hai
Woh fine-tune nahi ho sakta, is liye us ka rawaiya waqt ke saath kabhi nahi badalta
Usay kam compute chahiye, is liye woh sasta ho sakta hai aur chhote local devices par chal sakta hai
D1-083.exp: Small language models mein parameters kam hote hain, is liye unhein kam memory aur compute chahiye, woh tez jawab dete hain aur kam kharche mein ya devices par bhi chal sakte hain, aur bohat se markooz kaam achi tarah karte hain. Woh har kaam mein zyada sahi nahi hote; bare models aam taur par wasee ya mushkil soch mein behtar hote hain. Kisi model ki context window la-mehdood nahi, aur chhote models fine-tune ho sakte hain.

D1-084.q: Neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Temperature ko 0 ke qareeb rakhne se model ka output zyada qabil-e-andaza ho jata hai.
By default generative model jawab dene se pehle internet par talash karta hai.
Model sirf apne training cutoff tak ke facts janta hai, jab tak aap ki app usay taaza maloomat na de.
D1-084.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: kam temperature par model sab se mumkina tokens chunta hai, is liye jawab kam badalte hain. Doosre ka Nahi: model seekhe hue se text banata hai aur web nahi dekhta jab tak solution web grounding jaisa tool na jore. Teesre ka Haan: model us data se seekhta hai jo training cutoff se pehle jama hua, is liye naye facts dene parte hain, maslan retrieval ya search tool se.

D1-085.q: Kaunsa tareeqa is imkan ko sab se zyada kam karta hai ke chat solution company ke products ke baare mein facts khud se ghar le?
opts: Har prompt ko bharosemand product data se ground karna
Temperature barhana taake jawab zyada mukhtalif hon
Chhote prompts bhejna jin mein products ka koi izafi context na ho
System message hata dein
D1-085.exp: Grounding model ko jawab ke liye bharosemand aur mutalliqa content deti hai, aur citations maangne se yeh check karna aasan hota hai ke jawab usi content se aaye, jis se ghare hue facts kam hote hain. Zyada temperature randomness barhata hai aur ghari hui tafseel barha sakta hai. Context ya system message hatane se maloomat aur rahnumai khatam hoti hai, jis se be-bunyad jawab ka imkan barhta hai.

D1-086.q: GPT models generative pre-trained transformers hain. Ek waqt mein ek token kar ke text banane ke liye woh transformer architecture ka kaunsa hissa istemal karte hain?
opts: Sirf encoder
Decoder
Convolutional image network
Decision tree
D1-086.exp: GPT models decoder par mabni transformers hain: decoder ab tak ke tokens par attention istemal kar ke agla token predict karta hai, aur text isi tarah qadam ba qadam banta hai. Sirf encoder wale models, jaise BERT, zyada tar text samajhne aur us ki numaindagi ke liye hain, banane ke liye nahi. Convolutional networks aam taur par images ke liye hote hain, aur decision trees machine learning model ki alag qism hain.

D1-087.q: Har tafseel ko us technique se milayein jise woh bayan karti hai. Har technique ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Aap ke documents se mile hue hisse prompt mein shamil karna
Bohat se misaali inputs aur outputs par model ko mazeed train karna
Prompt mein kaam ki chand hal shuda misaalein shamil karna
Aisi hidayaat likhna jo model ka role aur usool tay karein
D1-087.exp: Retrieval augmented generation nikala hua content prompt mein jorta hai taake model aap ke data se jawab de. Fine-tuning bohat si misaalon par training jari rakhti hai aur model ka rawaiya badalti hai. Few-shot prompting prompt ke andar chand misaalein rakhti hai. System message role aur usool tay karta hai. Tokenization sirf text ko tokens mein torti hai aur jawab dene ka andaz nahi badalti.

D1-088.q: Tokens ke baare mein kaunse TEEN bayan sahi hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Model ka istemal aur kharcha aam taur par tokens mein naapa jata hai
Token hamesha bilkul ek poora lafz hota hai
Model ki context window tokens mein naapi jati hai
Tokens sirf image models ke liye istemal hote hain
Token kisi lafz ka hissa ho sakta hai
D1-088.exp: Istemal aur kharcha aam taur par tokens mein gina jata hai, context window tokens ki tadad hoti hai, aur tokenizers bohat se alfaaz ko tukron mein torte hain, is liye token lafz ka hissa ho sakta hai. Is liye token hamesha poora lafz nahi hota, aur tokens language models bhi istemal karte hain, sirf image models nahi.

D1-089.q: Har khali jagah ke liye sahi option chun kar jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-089.tpl: Generative AI apne training data se seekhe hue patterns ki bunyad par {0} content banata hai. Jo jawab sunne mein sahi lage lekin facts se sabit na ho usay {1} kehte hain.
D1-089.exp: Generative AI training mein seekhe hue patterns se naya content, jaise text, images ya code, banata hai, mehfooz content copy nahi karta. Aisa rawan jawab jis ki bunyad facts par na ho hallucination kehlata hai. Token text ki unit hai aur embedding numeric vector hai, is liye dono ghalat jawab ko bayan nahi karte.

D1-090.q: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) request ke qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: Index mein sawal se milte hue hisse talash karein
Nikale hue hisson ke saath prompt model ko bhejein
Grounded jawab wapas karein, behtar hai citations ke saath
Sawal par model ko fine-tune karein
D1-090.exp: RAG request user ke sawal se shuru hoti hai, phir index mein, aksar embeddings ke zariye, mutalliqa hisse talash hote hain, phir sawal un hisson ke saath model ko jata hai, aur aakhir mein un hisson par mabni jawab wapas aata hai, behtar hai citations ke saath. Fine-tuning alag training ka amal hai aur ek sawal ka jawab dene ka hissa nahi.

D1-091.q: Aap ko Foundry model catalog se aisa model chahiye jo record ki hui awaaz ko text banaye. Kaunsa model munasib hai?
D1-091.exp: whisper speech-to-text model hai jo audio likhta hai, aur speech ko English mein translate bhi kar sakta hai. gpt-image-1 tasveerein banata hai, text-embedding-3-small search ke liye embedding vectors banata hai, aur Phi-4 small language model hai jo text par kaam karta hai, is liye koi bhi audio nahi likhta.

D1-092.q: Model deploy karne se pehle aap us ki capabilities, istemal ke maqasid, hudood aur license kahan parh sakte hain?
opts: Subscription ka activity log
Catalog mein model card
Azure pricing calculator ka page
D1-092.exp: Foundry model catalog mein har model ka model card hota hai jo batata hai ke model kya karta hai, kaise train hua, us ke istemal ke maqasid aur hudood kya hain, aur license ki sharaait kya hain. Azure Advisor aam best-practice mashware deta hai, activity log management operations record karta hai, aur pricing calculator kharche ka andaza lagata hai; koi bhi model ki capabilities nahi batata.

D1-093.q: Finance team ko mushkil, kai qadam wali calculations aur planning ke liye model chahiye, jahan sahi hona raftar se zyada ahem hai. Unhein kis qism ka model chunna chahiye?
opts: Chhota aur tez chat model
Reasoning model
Embedding model
Speech synthesis model
D1-093.exp: Reasoning models jawab dene se pehle andar hi andar masle par sochte hain, jis se mushkil math, logic aur planning ke kaam behtar hote hain, lekin waqt aur tokens zyada lagte hain. Chhota tez model aasan aur jaldi jawabon ke liye behtar hai. Embedding models vectors dete hain aur speech synthesis models audio banate hain, is liye dono kai qadam wale masail hal nahi karte.

D1-094.q: Aap ka prompt template har jawab ke aakhir mein ### ka nishan lagata hai. Aap chahte hain ke model yeh nishan likhte hi generation rok de. Kaunsi setting istemal karni chahiye?
D1-094.exp: Stop sequence model ko batata hai ke muqarrar string, jaise ###, aate hi generation rok de, aur woh string output mein shamil nahi hoti. Temperature aur top P control karte hain ke tokens ka intikhab kitna random ho, aur presence penalty model ko naye mauzu laane par amada karta hai; koi bhi nishan par output khatam nahi karta.

D1-095.q: Ek model lambe jawabon mein wahi alfaz aur phrases dohrata rehta hai. Aap ko kaunsa parameter barhana chahiye?
opts: Stop sequences ki tadad
Deployment ka quota
D1-095.exp: Frequency penalty un tokens ka imkan kam karta hai jo output mein pehle se kai baar aa chuke hon, is liye model kam dohrata hai. Zyada response tokens lambe jawab dene deta hai lekin takrar kam nahi karta, stop sequences sirf nishan par output khatam karte hain, aur quota control karta hai ke deployment kitna traffic sambhal sakti hai.

D1-096.q: Deployments ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Provisioned deployments ka bill sirf un tokens ka aata hai jo aap waqai istemal karte hain.
Global Standard deployment kisi bhi Azure region mein requests process kar sakti hai.
Deployment ka tokens-per-minute quota yeh mehdood karta hai ke woh kitna traffic sambhal sakti hai.
D1-096.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: provisioned deployments provisioned throughput units mein capacity reserve karti hain, jis ki qeemat istemal ho ya na ho deni hoti hai; pay-per-token billing standard deployments ke liye hai. Doosre ka Haan: Global Standard traffic ko Azure ke global infrastructure par bhejta hai, is liye processing kisi bhi region mein ho sakti hai. Teesre ka Haan: jab requests tokens-per-minute hadd se barh jayein to izafi calls 429 errors ke saath reject hoti hain.

D1-097.q: Aap ko aise support chatbot ke liye model chunna hai jo paanch zabanon mein customers ki khidmat kare aur unhein kharab products ki photos upload karne de. Kaunse DO meyaar sab se ahem hain? Har sahi jawab hal ka ek hissa hai.
opts: Catalog mein model ka naam sab se lamba ho
Model image input ko support kare
Model sab se pehle release hua ho
Model customers ki zabanon mein acha kaam kare
Model sab se zyada GPUs istemal kare
D1-097.exp: Is scenario ko aisa multimodal model chahiye jo tasveerein le aur paanchon zabanon mein acha kaam kare, is liye faisla isi par hoga, aur yeh model cards aur apne tests se check ho sakta hai. Model ka naam, release ki tarteeb aur hardware ka istemal yeh nahi batate ke woh kaam ke liye munasib hai.

D1-098.q: Har tafseel ko deployment type se milayein. Har type ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Asynchronous bulk jobs, 24 ghante ka target aur kam qeemat
Musalsal traffic aur qabil-e-andaza latency ke liye reserved processing capacity
Fi token adaigi, aur requests kisi bhi Azure region mein process ho sakti hain
Fi token adaigi, aur processing data zone, jaise EU ya US, ke andar rehti hai
D1-098.exp: Global Batch bari asynchronous jobs ko 24 ghante ke target mein riayat par chalata hai. Provisioned deployments qabil-e-andaza karkardagi ke liye throughput reserve karti hain. Global Standard global routing ke saath pay-per-token hai. Data Zone Standard pay-per-token hai aur processing ko data zone, jaise EU, ke andar rakhta hai. Standard pay-per-token deployment hai jo processing ko ek Azure geography ke andar rakhti hai, jo yahan kisi tafseel se nahi milti.

D1-099.q: Har khali jagah ke liye sahi option chun kar jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-099.tpl: Jawab zyada se zyada kitna lamba ho, yeh mehdood karne ke liye {0} set karein. Model wahi alfaz kam dohraye, is ke liye {1} barhayein.
D1-099.exp: Max tokens un tokens ki tadad par hadd lagata hai jo model bana sakta hai, is liye jawab ki lambai mehdood hoti hai. Frequency penalty un tokens ka imkan kam karta hai jo pehle kai baar aa chuke hon, is liye takrar kam hoti hai. Temperature aur top P randomness control karte hain, aur stop sequences muqarrar string par output khatam karte hain, is liye yeh dono kaam seedha nahi karte.

D1-100.q: Ek team kam traffic par aur pehle se kisi commitment ke baghair jaldi se model azmana chahti hai. Baad mein production mein musalsal zyada traffic hoga jise guaranteed capacity chahiye. Unhein kya karna chahiye?
opts: Development ke liye provisioned throughput aur production ke liye Global Batch istemal karein
Pehle Global Standard, phir provisioned throughput
Development aur production dono ke liye Global Batch istemal karein
Koi deployment na banayein aur model catalog ko seedha call karein
D1-100.exp: Global Standard baghair commitment ke pay-per-token hai, jo tajurbe ke liye munasib hai, jab ke provisioned throughput musalsal aur qabil-e-andaza production workloads ke liye capacity reserve karta hai. Development mein provisioned capacity khali pari reserved units par paisa zaya karti hai, aur Global Batch asynchronous hai, is liye live users ko jawab nahi de sakta. Applications ke call karne se pehle models ko deploy karna ya instant-access option se istemal karna hota hai; catalog khud endpoint nahi.
